Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} and {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c}. 

Commanding {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} also causes {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} to focus the same target for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
